apps.title: My apps
apps.empty: Your apps will show up here. Add the ones your business needs.
apps.loadError: Could not load your apps. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, sign in again.

setup.title: Finish setting up your business
setup.unavailableHint: This one is on us: there is nothing on your side to do yet. We are on it.
setup.delegatedHint: An administrator has to set this up.
setup.completeBody: Everything on the checklist is done.
setup.loadError: Could not load what is left to set up
setup.loadErrorBody: Check the connection and try again.

widgets.empty: Empty panel. Tap ⋮ to add widgets.
widgets.none: No installed app offers widgets yet.
widgets.loadErrorBody: Check the connection and try again.

activity.loadError: Could not load the latest sales
activity.loadErrorBody: Check the connection and try again.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.loadError: Could not check the notifications. They will show up when the connection is back.

blocking.title: You cannot issue invoices yet
blocking.body: No ticket or invoice can be issued until this is set up:

appsPage.title: Apps
appsPage.buyWhere: Subscribed to on erplora.com, from your ERPlora account.
appsPage.loadError: We could not read your apps
appsPage.loadErrorBody: There was no answer, or this session is no longer valid: sign in again if it keeps happening.

empty.mine: You have no apps yet. Open “Add apps” to see them all.
empty.all: There are no apps to show.
empty.paid: No app is sold separately: every app comes with your plan.

appBlocked.checking: Checking why this app does not open…

subscription.heading: Subscription needed
subscription.body: {app} is disabled because this business does not have its subscription. Your data is safe and comes back as soon as it is subscribed to.

missing.heading: This app is not available in this business
missing.body: Look for it in Apps, or open another one from the menu.

error.heading: We could not check why this app does not open
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

systemPlan.title: System
systemPlan.heading: Your plan's limits
systemPlan.devicesNotCounted: The hub does not count its devices yet.

full.heading: You are running out of room in your plan
full.body: Your plan has every place taken, so you cannot add anyone else.

systemPlan.unknown: We do not know this business's plan yet: it shows up as soon as erplora.com sends it.
systemPlan.managed: Plans are managed from your ERPlora account, on erplora.com.
systemPlan.denied: Only whoever runs the business can see the plan and its limits.

error.heading: We could not read your plan
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

error.heading: We could not read the system
error.body: The figures and the logs are not available right now. You can try again.

resources.heading: Cloud resources
resources.notMeasured: CPU, memory and connections are not measured per business: ERPlora's servers serve every business at once and grow by themselves when needed.
resources.denied: Only the owner or an administrator can see how much the hub is using.

updates.heading: What we have updated
updates.auto: This hub updates itself when we publish a new version, without stopping the service: there is nothing to install.
updates.unknownDate: We do not know when this version was published.

failed.heading: Failed events
failed.hint: Fix the cause (a permission, an app that is off…) and resend. The event is never edited: if the cause is still there, it fails again and comes back here.
failed.notRetryable: This one cannot be resent: {app} is no longer on in this business. Turn it on and resend it.

empty.heading: All in order
empty.body: No failed events. The queue of events lives in the database: a restart never loses it.

failed.errorBody: The queue of failed events could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
failed.denied: Only the owner or an administrator can see the failed events.

retryAllConfirm.title: Resend every failed event?
retryAllConfirm.message: The ones that can be resent go back to the queue; those for an app that is off stay here.

discardConfirm.title: Discard this event for good?
discardConfirm.message: “{event}” will never reach {app} again. Who discarded it, when and why are kept.
discardConfirm.consequence: If it was a sale for Invoicing, that sale stays without its invoice.

reasons.gone: that event is no longer in the queue; refresh the list.
reasons.appOff: the app it was for is no longer on in this business; turn it on and resend it.
reasons.denied: only the owner or an administrator can do it.
reasons.unknown: the reason could not be read.

log.heading: Event log
log.empty: No events yet: nothing has gone between this business's apps.
log.error: The log could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
